heroSummary: Blue Valley students in grades 6 and 9 attend Transition Day on Wednesday, August 12, 2026. The first day for EC–12 is August 13, which is also kindergarten orientation day. Thanksgiving Break runs November 23–27, Winter Break December 21–January 1, and Spring Break March 15–19. Seniors' last day is May 14. The scheduled last day for grades K–11 is May 25, with early release; Early Childhood does not attend that day.

calendarNotes: Only grades 6 and 9 attend Transition Day on August 12; the EC–12 first day and kindergarten orientation are August 13. K–5 collaboration days do not close middle or high schools. customSections.label: How the Blue Valley 2026–27 Opening Works
customSections.content: Only students in grades 6 and 9 attend on August 12 for Transition Day. If your child is not in grade 6 or 9, use August 13 as the district's published first day; that date also includes kindergarten orientation.

table.caption: Blue Valley 2026–27 opening schedule
rows: First day of school; kindergarten orientation
table.footnote: Schools provide kindergarten orientation times and transition-day details.

customSections.label: Not Every Blue Valley No-School Day Applies to Every Grade
customSections.content: Blue Valley has several no-school days that apply only to certain grade levels. K–5 collaboration days do not affect middle or high school students, while EC–8 conference closures still have grades 9–12 in class.

table.caption: Student attendance rules in the Blue Valley 2026–27 calendar
rows: No School K–5 — Teacher Professional Collaboration

customSections.label: Blue Valley School Hours and Early Release Times
customSections.content: Blue Valley publishes a different early-release time for each school level. Its high schools follow an odd/even block schedule, and Blue Valley North begins five minutes earlier than the other high schools on Tuesday and Thursday.

table.caption: Blue Valley published school and early-release hours
rows: Mon./Wed. 7:35 a.m.; Tue./Thu. 8:35 a.m.; Fri. 7:35 a.m. — all end 2:45 p.m.
Mon./Wed. 7:35 a.m.; Tue./Thu. 8:30 a.m.; Fri. 7:35 a.m. — all end 2:45 p.m.
table.footnote: CAPS, Blue Valley Academy and Early Childhood programs publish their own schedules.

customSections.label: Blue Valley Year-End Dates by Grade Level
customSections.content: Blue Valley's school year ends on different dates depending on grade level. Seniors have their last day on May 14, tentative graduation dates are May 15–16, and grades 9–11 have early-release finals on May 21 and 24. Grades K–11 are scheduled to finish May 25; Early Childhood does not attend that day.
